# Epic: Desktop UI (v1)

**Slug:** desktop-ui
**Status:** ready
**Created:** 2026-10-13

## Goal

An Electron and React app for the v1 flows, built accessibly from the first screen, on the named-operation API of the core.

## Scope

- Hardened Electron shell and IPC boundary
- Setup, quick entry, journal, accounts, reports, settings
- Turkish and English, privacy mode, expert mode

## Out of Scope

- Mobile, UI plugins
